claims.statement: HAK-018 deterministically verifies retained pagination transcript structure: exact page order, continuation-edge equality, continuation-token non-reuse/cycle checks, and final terminal position under the declared pagination model; it does not establish that a continuation token was actually emitted by the provider response.

HAK-018 deterministically replays the supported stable-first-occurrence entity-id deduplication rule over the retained page transcript and reconciles raw/unique/duplicate counts with the bound HAK-017 declaration.

HAK-018 verification requires the exact loaded HAK-017 DeclaredComplete record as an external witness and binds its exact declaration digest plus collection/query/scope/pagination/count fields; an embedded binding, same-looking refs, or a different declaration cannot satisfy the join.

HAK-018 keeps provider authentication, raw-response content replay, continuation-source provenance, entity projection, and temporal snapshot consistency explicitly unestablished by retained-transcript replay; tested label substitution cannot promote those boundaries.

required_checks.description: Resolve, checkout, and assert the exact PR head.
Compile the HAK-018 retained traversal tooling.
Validate the HAK-018 JSON Schema syntax.
Lint the HAK-018 machine-readable qualification plan.
Lint the HAK-018 HAK-010 precommitted obligation-to-step binding policy.
Run focused HAK-018 traversal-chain, dedup replay, HAK-017 join, boundary, digest, and schema-parity regressions.

required_negative_cases: skipped continuation edge accepted
reused continuation token cycle accepted
duplicate page id accepted
final page retains continuation while traversal claims terminal
nonpaginated model accepts multiple pages
page observation window inverted
later page begins before prior response bound completed
dedup output changed after coherent redigest
HAK-017 retained counts differ from replayed transcript
HAK-017 source collection or scope differs from transcript
HAK-017 pagination contract differs from transcript
different HAK-017 declaration accepted under copied human-readable refs
provider authentication label promoted above NotEstablished
temporal verification promoted above NotEstablished
canonical profile identity substituted
traversal digest tampering accepted
unknown traversal record field accepted by schema
continuation source verification promoted above NotEstablished
raw response content verification promoted above NotEstablished
entity projection verification promoted above NotEstablished
verification accepted without exact HAK-017 witness
non-DeclaredComplete HAK-017 declaration accepted

independence.claim_interpretation: limited to deterministic verification of retained traversal transcript structure and edge consistency, supported dedup replay over retained entity identifiers, mandatory exact HAK-017 DeclaredComplete witness binding, canonical profile/digest integrity, and tested anti-oracle boundaries; does not authenticate provider responses, replay raw provider response bytes, prove retained entity identifiers/continuation tokens came from provider response content, establish actual provider exhaustion from external evidence, establish temporal snapshot stability, establish population-qualified selector coverage, establish semantic truth, upgrade upstream HAK qualification, or grant runtime authority
